study_design: Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial was conducted in 699 men at high risk for prostate cancer
reason: The trial evaluated incident prostate cancer after a negative baseline biopsy, but the abstract did not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal incident endpoint. The 74 total cases are supplied by the existing full-text evidence rather than the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared to placebo, the hazard ratios [95% confidence intervals] for risk of developing prostate cancer in the selenium 200 µg/day or the selenium 400 µg/day group were 0.94 [0.52, 1.7] and 0.90 [0.48, 1.7], respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported HR is for developing prostate cancer overall, with no aggressive-disease restriction.
